---------------------------------------------------------------------------
REFUSAL REASONS (Phase 021): the short physical reason a major-action attempt did not happen.

Each refusal point in the world's major-action primitives names one code from REFUSAL_REASONS. The world
keeps the code in a per-resident log of refused attempts (a Refusal node, bounded by REFUSAL_LOG_LIMIT) and
in counters by action and reason. The actor's own last outcome (applied, reason) is published to that actor
and to no one else, and the LLM prompt quotes the description. Descriptions are written for the resident
(second person). A code names the physical check that failed, never a judgement about the choice.

not_possible is the catch-all for a refusal whose check is not yet named. A report that shows it means a
refusal point still needs its own code.

REFUSAL_LOG_LIMIT: the number of refused attempts kept per resident, oldest dropped first. APPROX: a design
choice (no seed or source gives a figure). It bounds graph size for a 100-resident town, nothing else.

malformed.description: The proposal was incomplete or had a value of the wrong kind (a name or number missing, or not the right type).

unknown_target.description: The person, object, container, animal, crop, project, obligation or request named does not exist in this town.

wrong_target.description: The thing named exists, but this action cannot use it (the wrong animal kind, a dead animal or crop, a party you do not act for, or a container that cannot hold this kind of thing).

slot_used.description: You have already used your one major action this turn.

busy.description: You are still in the middle of a timed job. Finish it first; it waits while you are away from the place you started it.

asleep.description: You are asleep. You cannot act until you wake.

collapsed.description: You have collapsed from exhaustion and are asleep where you fell. You cannot act until you wake, and you wake weaker than a proper sleep leaves you.

too_tired.description: You are too exhausted to walk. Rest or sleep first.

not_in_reach.description: You are not close enough. You must stand on the same cell as the person, object, or place, or one step away.

not_at_site.description: You are not at the place this work needs: the store, the workplace, the building the recipe is done in, the gathering site, or the field or parcel.

out_of_stock.description: There is not enough of it. The store, the container, or the coin you hold is less than the amount asked for.

held.description: The holder kept hold of it. Your grab did not win the contest, or the holder braced and held.

evaded.description: The holder stepped out of reach before your grab landed, so nothing was taken.

dropped.description: The goods fell to the ground in the scuffle. Nothing is in your hands; they lie on the cell.

not_held.description: You do not hold it, so it cannot be dropped, given, eaten, or handed on.

no_capacity.description: It does not fit. Your carrying capacity, the container's volume, its load limit, or the serving vessel's size is full or too small.

no_tool.description: You do not have the tool or serving equipment this work needs in your hands or at your workplace.

unskilled.description: You are not skilled enough for this work, or your strength is below what it needs.

not_known.description: You do not know how to do this work.

out_of_season.description: It is not the season for this crop or this work.

on_cooldown.description: This cannot be done again yet. The animal or task has only just been tended.

not_ready.description: It is not ready yet (the crop is not mature, or the grave is not open or no body is waiting).

container_locked.description: The container is locked, and you do not hold its key.

invalid_destination.description: The place cannot be reached this way: it is the cell you already stand on, or it would put a container inside itself.

not_needed.description: It is not needed now: you are not hurt or hungry enough for this care, your stamina is high enough not to rest, or the crop does not need water.

unsupported.description: The world has no physical way to do this action yet.

not_possible.description: The attempt was refused for a physical reason that the world does not name more precisely.

no_lock.description: There is no lock on the container or the town store you named.

no_key.description: You do not hold a key that fits this lock.

already_authorised.description: You have already turned your key in this lock. It needs another keyholder to turn a key before it opens.

store_locked.description: The town store is locked. You do not hold a key that opens it alone, so you cannot take from it, put into it, or use its stock.
